title: AAOP GitHub Mission Task Contract
description: Machine-readable task contract consumed by the AAOP GitHub Mission Adapter. This schema is the AAOP-owned canonical authority for a single GitHub-Issue mission; the adapter validates structure against it and must not invent a second contract authority.

task_type.description: surgical = small, fully-specified task (STOP-WHEN/RETURN-WHEN may be omitted); autonomous = multi-round self-iterating mission (STOP-WHEN and RETURN-WHEN are required).

executor.description: The single primary executor. Maps to working-contract account/owner semantics: one task, one executor.

gate.description: Who holds advance/review authority after review. Exactly two classes (mirrors decision_ownership: agent-owned advance vs human-authority advance).

stop_when.description: Terminal success criterion for an autonomous task (reach it and stop). Required when task_type=autonomous.

return_when.description: Escalation condition: when hit, stop and return with evidence. Required when task_type=autonomous. Maps to AAOP escalation semantics (blockers / human_open_questions).
